title: Gantry & Fixture Vibration Investigation
instructions: Inspect linear stage bearings and clamping fixture mounts on Tab Laser Welding Cell M1. Re-torque clamping bolts and verify post-alignment vibration below 40 mm/s.
observations: Vibration exceeded 68 mm/s during high-speed tab welding. Fixture misalignment and loose clamping bolts suspected.

title: High Temperature Fault – Protective Optics Check
instructions: Inspect protective optics window and focusing lens assembly on M1 for weld spatter contamination. Replace protective window if hazing is found.
observations: Housing temperature exceeded 88°C. Chiller coolant flow was adequate.

title: Vibration Sensor Drift & Calibration Review
instructions: Check accelerometer stud torque and cable shielding on M1. Calibrate sensor against portable reference vibrometer.
observations: Alert occurred immediately after sensor replacement with steady baseline on reference meter.

title: Laser Chiller Coolant Line Troubleshooting
instructions: Inspect all chiller coolant lines and filter on M1. Replace kinked flexible tubing and test flow rate.
observations: Repeated E12 high-temp alerts above 85°C. Return coolant tubing found kinked during rapid gantry moves.

title: Linear Stage Bearing Inspection & Alignment
instructions: Inspect linear stage bearings and guide rails on M1. Replace worn bearing carriage and verify smooth travel.
observations: Previous run showed rising vibration trend above 55 mm/s. Bearing replacement restored 24 mm/s baseline.

title: Optical Housing Seal & Purge Gas Check
instructions: Inspect optical housing seals and argon purge loop on M1. Replace degraded seals and verify leak tightness.
observations: Intermittent thermal spikes above 82°C caused by contaminated purge air entering the optics housing.

title: Thermal & Vibration Sensor Calibration Routine
instructions: Calibrate IR thermal probe and gantry vibration accelerometer on M1 against reference instruments.
observations: Vibration sensor drifted by +12 mm/s over extended shift operation.

title: Post-Swap Laser Fixture Verification
instructions: Verify clamping fixture torque and laser focal offset after EV-PM-4C-S tooling changeover.
observations: Vibration peaked at 58 mm/s after changeover due to uneven fixture bolt torque.
